property.name: dfs.replication
property.description: Default block replication. The actual number of replications can be specified when the file is created. For 2-node cluster: use 2 For single node: use 1 For production (3+ nodes): use 3

property.name: dfs.namenode.name.dir
property.description: Determines where on the local filesystem the NameNode should store the name table (fsimage) and transaction logs. CRITICAL: Back up this directory regularly! Can specify multiple directories separated by commas for redundancy. Example: file:///data1/namenode,file:///data2/namenode

property.name: dfs.datanode.data.dir
property.description: Determines where on the local filesystem DataNodes should store their blocks. Can specify multiple directories separated by commas to use multiple disks. Example: file:///data1/datanode,file:///data2/datanode

property.name: dfs.namenode.http-address
property.description: The address and port for the NameNode web UI. Access at: http://m-1:9870

property.name: dfs.namenode.secondary.http-address
property.description: The address and port for the Secondary NameNode web UI.

property.name: dfs.blocksize
property.description: Default block size in bytes: 134217728 (128MB) Larger blocks (256MB): Better for large files, less metadata Smaller blocks (64MB): Better for small files, more parallelism

property.name: dfs.namenode.handler.count
property.description: Number of server threads for the NameNode to handle RPC requests. Default: 10 Formula: 20 * log2(cluster_size) Increase for high concurrency workloads.

property.name: dfs.datanode.handler.count
property.description: Number of server threads for DataNodes.

property.name: dfs.webhdfs.enabled
property.description: Enable WebHDFS (REST API) for accessing HDFS. Useful for web applications and remote access.

property.name: dfs.permissions.enabled
property.description: Enable HDFS permissions. Set to false for development if you encounter permission issues. Always enable in production for security.

property.name: dfs.datanode.max.transfer.threads
property.description: Maximum number of threads that DataNodes use for transferring data. Increase for high-throughput workloads.
